behaviors.name: Flicker
behaviors.intent: Candle flame: a soft, irregular flicker.
behaviors.source:
behavior Flicker
  var base = 0
  on start
    base = self.light.intensity
  end
  on tick
    let n = sin(time * 7.3 + self.id) * 0.5 + sin(time * 12.9 + self.id * 1.7) * 0.3 + sin(time * 23.0 + self.id * 0.3) * 0.2
    self.light.intensity = base * (1 + n * 0.14)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Sway
behaviors.intent: Hanging lanterns sway a little in the breeze.
behaviors.source:
behavior Sway
  var yaw = 0
  on start
    yaw = self.rotation.y
  end
  on tick
    self.rotation = (sin(time * 1.3 + self.id) * 4, yaw, cos(time * 1.1 + self.id * 0.7) * 4)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Glide
behaviors.intent: Wheel slowly on the thermals above the monastery, banking into the turn.
behaviors.source:
behavior Glide
  on tick
    let a = time * self.speed + self.phase
    self.position = (self.cx + cos(a) * self.r, self.h + sin(a * 2.3) * 2.5, self.cz + sin(a) * self.r)
    self.rotation = (sin(a * 2.3) * 6, 0 - a * 57.3, 0 - 14)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Flap
behaviors.intent: Slow, deep wingbeats.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.rotation = (0, self.side, sin(time * self.beat + self.phase) * 34 + 6)
end
